head: 79224f240cf020f73a9f492ce293d046fc0b7949

source.ref: https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/74715; AACR-Bench dataset.json rows 1105, 1106, 1108 (forbid seeds 2021, 2022, 2023); hand-checked 2026-10-23 by adjudicator after two blind vetters; licence Apache-2.0 read from LICENSE at head; metadata-misaligned fixed upstream by 8344cd2e64c (#75127, merged 262101ea4ab on 2025-01-29), the row 1108 suggestion applied by 9bacaff3540 before #74715 merged

rationale: The change lets the batched set-processing path of unordered S3Queue/AzureQueue skip a file that another table on the same server holds, then compacts new_batch but not file_metadatas. metadata-misaligned is not among AACR-Bench's references: both blind vetters found it independently while checking the callers at head. It is true (next() returns object_infos[index] with file_metadatas[index], and the source then commits through that metadata), in the diff, and fixed by the author eleven days later in #75127 by compacting both vectors, so it is required as author-fix. row-1108 (a person's comment) is optional: resize then indexed assignment through a const reference does default-construct every slot and copy each pointer, and the author applied the suggestion before merge, but it is a micro-optimization off any demonstrated hot path, outside the performance reviewer's contract; the adjudicator sided with vetter B over dropping it, as ADR-0036 keeps true out-of-contract claims optional. Dropped by both vetters: row 1105, since releasing the processing lock before the keeper multi runs has no wrong outcome (the ephemeral processing-node create makes a conflicting multi fail and fall back to per-file trySetProcessing, and upstream kept this scope); row 1106, since log wording is style and its only caller already treats nullopt as a skip. No forbid range: seed 2021 is praise; seed 2022's premise (no direct include of optional in the header) is true at head, and include hygiene the build already satisfies is compiler or style territory, not a false claim; seed 2023's log count is true at head, since new_batch still holds the null slots when it logs.

expect.concern: When a skipped file precedes a kept one, new_batch is compacted but file_metadatas keeps its original positions, so next() pairs later objects with another file's metadata: debug builds abort on the path-mismatch assertion and release builds record the object's processed or failed state under the wrong file.

The compaction default-constructs every slot with resize and then copies each pointer, because std::move on a const reference does not move, where reserve and push_back over non-const elements would do neither.
